title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
factSummary: OpenAI describes Asana testing an optimized browser-agent workflow. The reported cost and speed improvements compare particular tested setups; they are not a guarantee for every browser task.

title: Sanas Introduces Supervised AI, Putting a Human at the Helm of Every AI Customer Conversation
factSummary: In its October 8 announcement, Sanas describes AI handling customer calls while a human supervisor monitors them and can intervene. This describes the company’s announced design, not independently verified service quality.
